question: What form of the aghora weapon will be expounded to the twice-born?
premises: The speaker transitions to a new exposition.
The subject is the aghora weapon.
It is described as having the nature of a garland of seed-syllables.
inference: Therefore, the aghora weapon to be taught is characterized as a garland of seed-syllables.
plain_english: Therefore, O twice-born ones, I will speak of the aghora weapon, whose nature is a garland of seed-syllables.
